# aidial_role (Data Source)

Looks up an existing DIAL Core role without managing it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "aidial_role" "existing" {
  bucket = "platform"
  path   = "my-role"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

- `path` (String)
